newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Honko seen in HK$100 mln IPO -- report.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Honko seen in HK$100 mln IPO -- report.

text.p: Electronics components maker and distributor Honko International Holdings Ltd plans to raise HK$70 million to HK$100 million through an initial public offering of shares in Hong Kong, newspapers reported on Monday.
Proceeds will be used to finance purchase of production machinery, reducing debt and for general working capital, the newspapers said. They gave no further details on the flotation.
Honko officals were not available for comment.
